_doc: Declarative world spec for cw01-e06 (representation ecology). Written during PREFLIGHT, before implementation. Two substrates express overlapping solutions to a representation-blind task. Every difference between them arises mechanically from the substrate; nothing in scoring or selection reads the substrate label. The question is ECOLOGICAL - persistence, invasion, displacement, coexistence, frequency dependence - not which representation computes better.
_path_policy: Every e06 module resolves roots via lib/repopath.find_root / find_campaign_root. NO parents[N] assumptions anywhere (CW01-D046).

task._blind: The reward function reads OUTPUTS ONLY. It never receives, inspects or branches on the substrate label. There is no representation-specific bonus anywhere in scoring or selection.
task.form: map an input vector to one output value
task.target: a hidden family of functions over the inputs, drawn ONCE per attempt_id
task.target_family: straight-line DAGs over {add, sub, mul, min, max, gate} spanning a REUSE spectrum
task._canonical_form: An OPERATION GRAPH with explicit dependencies, evaluated by memoised recursion. NOT a straight-line instruction list: that would be TAPE semantics with a TREE compiler, handing one substrate the canonical form for free (CW01-D055, operator constraint 1). Both substrates receive the same semantic object and each pays its OWN realisation cost - TAPE holds a shared node in a register, TREE must DUPLICATE the sub-graph beneath it.
task._reuse_is_environmental: reuse is the fraction of nodes consumed more than once (fan-out > 1). It is a property of the ENVIRONMENT, not a representation label, and is swept over preregistered bands. The precondition (operator constraint 2) is that ONE generator yields regions where Delta(r) = F_TREE(r) - F_TAPE(r) is positive AND regions where it is negative.
task._non_degeneracy: CW01-D055: the previous generator emitted a CONSTANT target at reuse=0.50 (1 distinct output over 400 draws) and only 7 at reuse=0.00, which makes solve-rates meaningless. Graphs are now rejection-sampled until they produce at least min_distinct_outputs over their own input domain. input_domain is deliberately UNCHANGED - the instruction was to change the target family and nothing else.
task._history: CW01-D054. The first version generated the target as a depth-3 EXPRESSION TREE - one substrate's native form. Scoring was blind but the WORLD was not. Across the tested frequencies TREE's measured lower envelope (0.345) exceeded TAPE's measured upper envelope (0.289): no observed crossing, no mutual invasibility in the exercised domain. The generator is retained as world_e06.legacy_tree_target, an adversarial FIXTURE the Q16 gate must be shown REFUSING.
task.score: 1 / (1 + mean absolute error) over the episode's items
task._swept: n_inputs and target depth are world parameters and are SWEPT, never fixed at one convenient value

substrates._critical: Both substrates reach an overlapping solution set, so the SAME solution is expressible in either. Differences below are mechanical consequences of the form, not scoring rules.

TREE.form: expression tree over {add, sub, mul, min, max, gate} and input leaves
TREE.recombination: subtree crossover; requires a TREE partner
TREE._tradeoff: compact and cheap, but its mutations are disruptive

TAPE.form: linear instruction list, each 'op dst src1 src2' over R registers; inputs preloaded, output read from register 0
TAPE.mutation: single instruction edit - LOCAL, small effect
TAPE.recombination: one-point crossover; requires a TAPE partner
TAPE._tradeoff: costlier per unit of function, but incrementally improvable

substrates._balance: TREE is cheaper; TAPE hill-climbs more reliably. Neither is structurally destined to dominate - that would not be an ecology experiment (design requirement 4).

prices._one_price_list: ONE price list applied to whatever structure a substrate actually has. TREE pays per node; TAPE pays per instruction AND per live register, at the SAME unit price. TREE pays nothing for registers because it has none - that is mechanical, not a discount.

genome._shape: a substrate tag plus the substrate's own body, plus 2 neutral genes
genome._neutral: no phenotype by construction; the drift floor and the basis of label-matched shams
genome._organism_cannot_read_its_label: no decision path in the organism, the scorer or the selector branches on substrate_tag; the tag exists only for bookkeeping and for recombination compatibility, which is the mechanism under test

sharing._why: CW01-D052. Each item is a RESOURCE; organisms that solve it SPLIT its value. Representation-blind: it keys on WHICH ITEMS ARE SOLVED, never on the substrate label. Supplies the NEGATIVE frequency-dependence channel that assortative recombination cannot provide - a common strategy dilutes its own reward, so rare types gain. Without it the world was a fixation lottery: 18/18 fixed, 0/18 coexistence, and control A fixed 6/6 with no representational difference at all.
sharing._disabling_is_a_control: sharing.enabled=false restores the unshared world and should restore the lottery; that contrast is itself a control on the mechanism

ecology._elite_fraction_retired: retained for signature stability only. Deterministic truncation over 24 elites let drift dominate and is why control A fixed 6/6 (D052); selection is now a tournament.
ecology._mechanism_under_test: recombination compatibility is ASSORTATIVE by substrate: TREE x TREE and TAPE x TAPE recombine, TREE x TAPE does not. A rare substrate finds fewer compatible partners, so its recombination yield falls with its own frequency -> predicted POSITIVE frequency dependence.
ecology._competing_mechanism: the cost of maintaining explicit intermediate structure may vary with population composition -> NEGATIVE frequency dependence and coexistence. Both remain reachable, as does no frequency dependence at all.

arms._critical: Arms are transformations applied UP FRONT so every arm runs identical code (CW01-D019/D021). Item draws come from a stream seed that never sees the arm.

mixed_neutralised._tests: M3 - the hypothesised mechanism is removed while LABELS remain. If the ecological effect survives, representation identity is a proxy or the measurement is contaminated.

solo_tree._tests: intrinsic advantage of TREE, free of interaction

solo_tape._tests: intrinsic advantage of TAPE, free of interaction

control_same_substrate._tests: CONTROL A - two lineage labels over ONE substrate. Estimates ecological noise with no representational difference, and supplies the measured band for beta.

measurements._three_layers_never_collapsed: TASK, REPRESENTATION and ECOLOGY are recorded separately. Task success is NOT ecological success.
measurements._trajectories: frequency TRAJECTORIES are recorded per generation, never only endpoints

primary_statistic.name: frequency_dependence_of_the_interaction_term
primary_statistic.definition: r_A(f) = per-capita growth advantage of substrate A in MIXED populations seeded at frequency f; s_solo = A's advantage implied by SOLO lanes on matched worlds (frequency-independent by construction); interaction(f) = r_A(f) - s_solo; beta = slope of interaction(f) in f over the seeded frequency grid

reading.beta_zero: frequency-independent; the mixed outcome is explained by intrinsic advantage alone - an ecological NULL even if one substrate fixes
reading.beta_negative: negative frequency dependence; rare-advantage; coexistence predicted
reading.beta_positive: positive frequency dependence; common-advantage; contingent dominance

primary_statistic._terminal_abundance: recorded, but NEVER the verdict quantity. The biggest conceptual trap in this experiment is reading terminal abundance as ecology.

qualify_predicates._rule: ALL must pass before science budget is spent. Most are STANDING GATES promoted from e01-e05 failures.
qualify_predicates.Q1_prices_positive_and_shared: every price > 0 and ONE price list applies to both substrates
qualify_predicates.Q2_overlapping_expressiveness: a target solvable in TREE is measurably solvable in TAPE and vice versa - MEASURED by construction and evaluation, not asserted
qualify_predicates.Q3_scoring_is_representation_blind: no scoring or selection path reads substrate_tag; verified structurally and by a label-permutation test that must leave every score bit-identical
qualify_predicates.Q4_seeds_reconstructible: lib/seeds.py re-asserted cross-process for this attempt_id
qualify_predicates.Q5_durable_without_redis: a row written and re-parsed with the redis import blocked
qualify_predicates.Q7_selection_actually_binds: a competent organism reliably out-reproduces an incompetent one
qualify_predicates.Q8_learnability_in_BOTH_substrates: STANDING GATE: a hand-built COMPETENT organism beats a hand-built INCOMPETENT one in EACH substrate separately; probes asserted pairwise distinct (D023)
qualify_predicates.Q9_mechanism_fires: recombination is actually attempted and assortment is measurable: cross-substrate attempts are refused in assortative arms and permitted in neutralised arms, with counts recorded
qualify_predicates.Q10_matched_arms: with the mechanism neutralised, treatment and control produce BIT-IDENTICAL metrics from the same stream seed, on a LIVE population (D034: not on one where nothing happened)
qualify_predicates.Q11_beta_has_a_noise_floor: beta must clear a band built from control_same_substrate across independent seed blocks (D035)
qualify_predicates.Q12_disposition_rule_is_executable: disposition computed by lib/lineage.decide; a branch is UNREACHABLE unless its tests ran (D024)
qualify_predicates.Q13_organism_cannot_read_its_label: no decision path in organism, scorer or selector branches on substrate_tag
qualify_predicates.Q14_latent_facts_attempt_stable: target structure drawn ONCE per attempt (D029/D037); items drawn per episode
qualify_predicates.Q15_no_unperformed_checks: every logged test names the comparison it performed (D031)
qualify_predicates.Q16_all_outcomes_reachable: TREE fixes, TAPE fixes, stable coexistence, contingent dominance and no-difference must EACH be demonstrably attainable. A design where one substrate is destined to dominate is not an ecology experiment.
qualify_predicates.Q17_intrinsic_separable_from_interaction: solo lanes exist, are matched to the mixed lanes' worlds, and yield s_solo independently of any mixed run
qualify_predicates.Q18_inherited_gates_proven: ENGINEERING TARGET: repopath discovery from >=2 directory depths; recordsafety refusing an unsafe fixture; tally agreement refusing drifted state; guardproof refusing a vacuous proof; and no git write while a live RowWriter exists. Each by OBSERVED REFUSAL.

backend_counterfactual.requirement_IX: organism-visible physics must not depend on one implementation
backend_counterfactual.secondary_backend: independent reimplementation of the TAPE interpreter using an explicit stack machine, and of TREE evaluation using an iterative post-order walk
backend_counterfactual.equivalence_test: identical per-organism metric vectors from identical seeds
backend_counterfactual.cap_rule: if not exercised within timebox, disposition is capped at INCONCLUSIVE and may NOT be COMPLETE

dispositions.NEGATIVE: no task-capable organisms in either substrate, or the task is unlearnable
dispositions.NULL: substrates compute differently but no ecological quantity clears its measured null
dispositions.INCONCLUSIVE: the ecological interaction was not genuinely exercised, or a measure cannot clear its null, or IX not discharged, or not replicated
dispositions.COMPLETE: representation changes an ecological quantity; the decisive effect clears its null, survives control A, is abolished or materially reduced by M3, and holds in EVERY replicate
dispositions._not_complete: COMPLETE is explicitly NOT 'TREE wins'. A substrate fixing is not by itself evidence of ecology.
